ways.label: Young Australian Historic Reserve to Felton Road car park

start.name: top of the Young Australian Historic Reserve
start.quote: top of the Young Australian Historic Reserve

evidence: This well-defined farm road starts at the top of the Young Australian Historic Reserve at the high altitude of 1250 m.
It continues on to Felton Road car park via Long Gully Loop Track and Bannockburn Sluicings Track.
Follow this for 4.5 km to a junction in the road and the start of the Slapjack Saddle Track.

doubts: No feature for the start (a junction on the Young Australian Historic Reserve 4WD road, 4.5 km from Nevis Road), so the start has no ref. The text says the track passes through Potters Creek Conservation Area and gives access to Slapjack Saddle; I took Slapjack Saddle as on the way because the Slapjack Creek side trip branches off the track there. The page also says that while Long Gully Loop Track is closed for lambing you must return via the Young Australian Historic Reserve Road; this seasonal out-and-back is not recorded as a separate way. The 1220 Track's departure point is not stated.
